verdict.rationale: Postmark exposes webhooks for real-time event notifications (delivery, bounce, open/click) that can trigger downstream automations, and community evidence confirms an official MCP server exists (postmarkapp.com/lp/mcp) enabling AI agents to interact with the API programmatically. However, there's no evidence of a built-in scheduler, workflow engine, or autonomous background automation runner within Postmark itself — the 'automation' capability relies entirely on external glue code reacting to webhooks or an agent calling the API on demand, and community reports note the official MCP repo has very low adoption (1 watch, 0 forks, 2 stars), casting doubt on its real-world use. Missing for 10: native scheduled/recurring automation features, evidence of autonomous multi-step workflows, and stronger adoption/corroboration of the MCP server in production use.
